newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine spot cash wheat firms on looming rain.
newsitem.headline: Argentine spot cash wheat firms on looming rain.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat firmed on forecasts of rain this the weekend in key southern grain areas, which could lead to harvest delays, traders said.

Buenos Aires cash wheat firmed $2, to $134, price paid to farmers, in tight trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange. April cash maize also firmed $1 to $98 in slow trade, as exporters took positions. May soybeans rose $2 to $235, in steady buying. Both the soybean and maize crops are doing well. Not so the sunflower crop. Concern over northern crop weather kept prices steady in slow trade. March sunseed was going for $214.
